target_customer: Interior builders, contractors, designers and custom woodworkers who need wood parts and furniture produced on demand; supply side is small woodworking manufacturers
problem: Small woodworking businesses serve a large share of the woodworking market but work through manual quoting and file handling. Cutr digitizes file checks, quoting, matching and logistics so customers upload a file and receive parts.
business_model: Marketplace taking a margin on manufacturing jobs, with quoting, logistics and payments handled on the platform

founders.name: Oscar Peppitt
founders.background_notes: YC page: early Uber employee who launched its transport business in APAC and UberEats in APAC and EMEA, and worked on self-driving cars.

founders.name: Rodny Heemskerk
education: Industrial design training (institution not named on the YC page)
previous_startups: A manufacturing business (unnamed on the YC page)
founders.background_notes: YC page: CAD/CAM engineer; Lean Startup Machine 2013, Kickstarter campaign 2015.

founders.name: Jasper Mittelmeijer
founders.background_notes: YC page: built the procedural furniture generator and CNC controller that started Cutr.

competitors.name: Wikifactory
competitors.what: Manufacturing marketplace with online quotes for CNC machining and other processes, not wood specific

technical_complexity.rationale: Automated file checks and instant quoting for CNC wood parts require custom geometry and CAM logic, plus marketplace operations; standard engineering with some hard parts.

defensibility.rationale: Supply network of manufacturers and quoting software help, but online CNC ordering services existed and a marketplace is copyable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source found of an incumbent copying or buying Cutr.

market_need_then: The YC page says small woodworking businesses serve about 60% of a 1.4T USD global woodworking market, a company claim; no dated demand evidence beyond that was found.

branding.domain_note: Moved from cutr.ai to cutr.com (301 redirect seen when fetched in 2026), suggesting the company later acquired the .com.

rebrands.why: Domain change only; company name is unchanged, reason not stated

brand_strength.rationale: Only company pages and directory entries were found; no press about the brand.

pivots.from: Wood parts marketplace for woodworkers and designers (YC page, 2022)
pivots.to: Interior production from quote to installation across Europe with 250+ manufacturers (site, 2026)
pivots.why: not stated; positioning shift seen by comparing sources, date unknown

outcome_analysis: Cutr, an Amsterdam based YC Winter 2022 company, raised a seed round in 2022 and by 2026 claims 2,000 plus projects, over 1,000 customers and 250 plus manufacturers in Europe. Funding amounts are unclear across sources, so growth relative to capital cannot be judged. It remains active.
notes: Foundamental's portfolio page confirms a 2022 seed investment with no amount. SeedTable lists a 500K USD pre-seed in Jan 2022 and VCBacked shows 4.9M total and a Jan 2024 round; both are aggregator-only and unverified, so not recorded as rounds. VCBacked also names Karman Ventures, Soma Capital and Timon Capital; unverified. The Wikifactory announcement is dated June 2022, after the batch start, and is not wood specific. Founder education beyond the YC page text is null. Ponoko and SendCutSend offered online CNC wood cutting but no dated source was found.
